title: Mask Keeper - Act 2 Boss Guide (Location, Weakness & How to Beat)
description: Mask Keeper in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - where to find it, its elemental weakness and resistances, and how to beat it. Act 2, Visages.

facts.label: Key Drops
facts.value: Colour of Lumina · Grandiose Chroma Catalyst

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Mask Keeper is the second stage of the Visages fight - the real Axon behind the masks. It cannot be reached independently: you get here by finishing Visages in the same encounter, and the mask mini-bosses you cleared beforehand decide how much it can buff itself.

sections.title: Where to Find the Mask Keeper
sections.content: Location: the Visages area, Act 2, immediately after the Visages stage. It also appears separately in the Endless Tower.

Same profile as Visages: weak to Fire and Dark, resists Ice. Nothing changes between the stages, so a party built for stage one is already correct for stage two.

sections.title: How to Beat the Mask Keeper
sections.content:
Clear the Vales first

Mask Keeper draws extra abilities from the three Vale bosses in the Visages area - Jovial Moissonneuse, Seething Boucheclier and Sorrowful Chapelier. Defeating each of them before the main fight removes one of those buffs, which is the single largest difficulty swing available to you.

Long combos

It favours extended multi-hit strings. If your parry timing breaks down mid-combo, a revenge-style skill that scales with damage taken is a reasonable safety net rather than losing the turn entirely.

  • Kill the three Vale bosses first - it directly weakens this fight.
  • Fire and Dark, same as Visages.
  • Expect no gap between the Visages stage and this one.

map.directions: Same arena as Visages - stage two begins immediately, with no travel between.
